audit_result.proof_trace: `getDailyAttendanceDetails` uses `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (bypasses RLS) and contains no `is_admin` check. Its sole client-side caller is `OverallAttendanceCalendar.tsx` (L43), which is mounted on `/dashboard/overall` — a route protected only by the dashboard layout (authentication only, no admin gate). The `dashboard/overall/page.tsx` fetches `is_admin` at L18-28 but never conditionally gates rendering of the calendar component.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin member navigates to `/dashboard/overall`, triggering `OverallAttendanceCalendar` to call the `getDailyAttendanceDetails` server action for any selected date; the function returns all members' cross-user attendance details (by team and grade) using the admin Supabase client, with no authorization check.

PROP-e5782b58-pre-020.text: Admin aggregate view must verify is_admin before returning cross-user attendance data.
